instruction: Approve all venmo payment requests from my roommates from this calendar month.
notes: Roommates are discovered via phone.search_contacts(relationship="roommate"); pending received Venmo requests are listed via venmo.show_received_payment_requests(status="pending") and filtered to those sent by a roommate and created in June 2023 (current month). The world facts (who is a roommate, which request was sent by whom, which are pending and from this month) are static :init facts the planner needs, while the nullary knowledge predicates roommates-found / received-requests-found gate the approve action so the lookups must precede approvals. The exact number of qualifying requests is unknown a priori; the reference solution's 9 API calls imply 3 approvals, so the problem instantiates 2 roommates and 3 pending requests (placeholder count; adjust objects/init/goal and the arity of supervisor-complete-task if the real data differs). supervisor-complete-task takes the three distinct approved task records as non-API parameters (using :equality for distinctness) so its precondition is the lifted conjunction of the goal; it has no answer since the task is not a question. Only approved_at changes on the requests (approval uses Venmo balance, no payment_card_id passed).
